title: My first weeks in MDS
text:
Hiking Brunswick!


My first few weeks of MDS have been a busy, but fun, blur. From landing in Vancouver just a few days before orientation to now, it feels like months already. I have been fortunate to meet such amazing and interesting people and it has made the transition so much more enjoyable. The picture above is of me and two program friends as we summitted Mt.Brunswick
The first week of classes felt daunting, but working my way through the worksheets and labs helped me feel like I actually was in control. The program is a wild and rushing river. I can’t stop the flow of it, but I can learn to flow with it. Get as much done each day, keep well rested and fed, believe in myself, and I will find that I have passed through the rapids in no time!

title: About
text: My name is Jonah Sider-Echenberg and I am a Graduate Student at the University of British Columbia’s Masters of Data Science program. I am originally from Ottawa, where I lived for 25 years, but I am now located in beautiful Vancouver! When I am not busy studying, you can find me playing soccer, cheering for FC Barcelona, playing Magic the Gathering, and fidgeting with my espresso machine that just won’t pull the coffee right!

title: Jonah Sider-Echenberg
text: Hello! Welcome to my website :) My name is Jonah Sider-Echenberg and I am a Graduate Student at the university of British Columbia’s Masters of Data Science program. I hold a Bachelor’s degree in Economics from Carleton University. After my undergrad, I worked at the Bank of Canada as a research assistant in the Department of Financial Stability from 2023 to 2025. And just before my masters, I spent the year travelling around the world! I am hoping to expand my understanding of data, specifically my experience with machine learning and build on my previous modelling and forecasting work.
